recognize_zh: 抹片與切片中黑色箭頭指出胞質呈皺紙樣纖維狀（crumpled tissue paper）的大型 Gaucher 細胞，藍色箭頭指出漿細胞；CD138 免疫染色顯示成群漿細胞，表示 Gaucher 病合併漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale blue fibrillary cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei (Gaucher cells, black arrows, A-B)
Admixed plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm (blue arrows)
Hypercellular marrow with sheets of pale Gaucher cells replacing fat on H&E (C, E)
CD138 immunostain highlighting increased clusters and sheets of plasma cells (D)
Dark chromogenic stain highlighting clustered cells (F), likely light-chain in situ hybridization
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (A) shows large histiocytes with abundant fibrillary, crumpled tissue paper-like cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei, admixed with plasma cells. The trephine biopsy (B, C, E) shows interstitial and sheet-like infiltrates of pale Gaucher cells with interspersed plasma cells. CD138 immunohistochemistry (D) highlights increased plasma cells in clusters and sheets, and an additional chromogenic stain (F) highlights clustered cells, likely representing light-chain in situ hybridization. Findings are consistent with Gaucher disease with concurrent plasma cell myeloma; clonality should be confirmed by kappa/lambda studies and serum protein electrophoresis.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells in chronic myeloid leukemia or myeloma
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are morphologically similar but arise from high cell turnover with normal glucocerebrosidase activity, whereas true Gaucher disease shows enzyme deficiency and GBA1 mutations.

ddx.dx: Reactive polyclonal plasmacytosis in Gaucher disease
ddx.vs: Gaucher disease commonly has polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia with scattered plasma cells, whereas myeloma shows sheets of CD138-positive cells with light-chain restriction.
Mycobacterium avium-laden histiocytes can appear striated but are acid-fast positive with granular rather than fibrillary PAS pattern.
Niemann-Pick foam cells have bubbly lipid vacuoles rather than fibrillary crumpled tissue paper cytoplasm.

stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD138; ISH (likely light chain)
